title: Diagnosing COVID-19 Pneumonia from X-Ray and CT Images using Deep Learning and Transfer Learning Algorithms
summary: CNN and modified AlexNet were tested for COVID classification on mixed-source X-ray/CT images; test sensitivities are promising but based on only 50 X-rays and 17 CTs, with no clinical utility established.
ai_technology: CNN and modified AlexNet classify mixed-source COVID/normal images.
